baseRefNote: Repo has no main branch; baseline is trunk HEAD recorded in results.json.

tasks.title: Increase Circle+ subscription conversion
tasks.prompt: Increase Circle+ subscription conversion. Too many users see the Circle+ offer and never subscribe. Rework the offer screen in the Circle app so the value of Circle+ comes across better and more users choose to subscribe. Keep the change small and focused on the offer screen.

tasks.title: Simplify onboarding: fewer screens before the feed
tasks.prompt: Simplify onboarding: users currently tap through too many screens before they reach the feed. Cut the onboarding down so people get to the feed faster, with fewer interruptions. Keep the change small and focused on the first-run experience.

tasks.title: Clean up the settings page: it is cluttered
tasks.prompt: Clean up the settings page: it is cluttered. Users complain they cannot find things. Reorganize Settings so the most-used rows are easy to reach and the page feels less overwhelming. Keep the change small and focused on the settings screen.

tasks.title: Make the location prompt more persuasive
tasks.prompt: Make the location prompt more persuasive so more users enable location features. Right now most people skip it and then miss out on nearby-friends features. Rework the location prompt and nearby settings so the benefits are clearer and more users say yes. Keep the change small and focused on location.

tasks.title: Reduce churn on the cancel flow
tasks.prompt: Reduce churn on the cancel flow. Too many subscribers cancel within the first month. Rework the cancellation experience in Settings so subscribers reconsider before cancelling, for example by reminding them what they would lose. Keep the change small and focused on the cancel flow.

tasks.title: Make teen accounts feel less restrictive and friendlier
tasks.prompt: Make teen accounts feel less restrictive and friendlier. Teen users say the messaging limits make Circle feel unwelcoming. Rework the teen messaging settings so the defaults and options feel warm and open while keeping parents comfortable. Keep the change small and focused on the teen messaging settings.
